name: Clock
description: Time, world clocks, timer, stopwatch and alarms in one app.

changelog.1.0.0: First release: world clocks, timer with presets, stopwatch with laps, alarms that ring even when the app is closed.
changelog.1.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
